title: 9 Sins a Godly Man Puts to Death Before They Grow
caption:
9 sins a godly man puts to death before they grow.

Kill them small, not after they've grown.

Put to death, therefore, whatever belongs to your earthly nature (Colossians 3:5). Scripture never says manage your sin. It says kill it, while it's still small enough to kill.

The private tab. The joke that's really contempt. The resentment he's been calling discernment. None of these show up fully grown. They start small enough to ignore, which is exactly why he doesn't.
